title: Minimum Density Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the minimum density of the Crab pulsar using the relationship between centripetal and gravitational forces.

title: Final Density Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a numerical value for the minimum density, approximately 1.3 x 10^14 kg/m^3.

title: Maximum Radius Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the density relationship to derive the maximum possible radius of the pulsar.

title: Final Radius Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a numerical value for the maximum radius, approximately 150 km.

title: Nuclear Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the nuclear density and relate it to the radius of the pulsar.

title: Final Nuclear Radius Value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a numerical value for the radius when using nuclear density, approximately 17 km.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of gravitational equations.
